sloka: ऋतुस्नाताम् सतीम् भार्यामृतुकालानुरोधिनीम् ।अतिवर्तेत दुष्टात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५२॥
transliteration: ṛtusnātām satīm bhāryāmṛtukālānurodhinīm ।ativarteta duṣṭātmā yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-52॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person who neglects his chaste wife observing the menstrual period unfavourable for conception and had bathed after menstruation acquires
